meaning: Log and monitor authorized users, agents included; MFA; oversee service providers; tell the FTC within 30 days when 500 or more consumers are affected
statusText: Binding now for non-bank financial firms

citation.clause: 16 CFR 314.4(j): notify the FTC within 30 days when 500 or more consumers are affected
citation.edition: CFR annual edition 2026, Title 16 Vol. 1 (revised 2026-01-01), GPO govinfo

dateNotes: In force; no source in scope gives the date paragraph (j) took effect (the eCFR version history P1-17 read lists 2024-05-13 as the section's latest amendment, which is not recorded here as (j)'s effective date). The legal reviewer records it.
